techniques.evidence: lib/analysis/kg-money-reingest.test.ts:11 The test drives the shared predicate, not the script's adoption of it (kg-money-ingest.ts:137); git grep finds no test covering the call site, so the 'end-to-end' claim overstates. lib/analysis/public-copy.test.ts:81 This structural pin's needle is a bare identifier that prose can spell, so a comment explaining the field in any of the three pinned files turns the suite red (getProfileData.ts:298 already talks around the name). lib/analysis/kg-money-reingest.test.ts:152 The file carries an in-suite control arm: a naive re-ingest without the merge is shown to revert review_state, so the defect the positive test guards is observed firing.

lib/analysis/money-feed.test.ts:38 The Hlídač/ARES client parsing is tested against hand-written fixtures 'modeled on' captured responses. This is the hand-written-fake option the technique rejects for a non-trivial remote shape.
